messages:
zoe: quick brain-dump: propose a 'soft-landing incentive' flow for customers pinned to legacy models. idea = standardized, automated path to move them to current catalog with clear credits and guardrails.
zoe: must-have parts: preflight checks, canary runbook, credit calculation, ledger events for billing, and legal amendment template.
carlos: agree. for credits prefer invoice-line release for enterprise and token grants for self-serve. ledger_event_id mandatory so finance can reconcile.
meera: on preflight: tokenizer compatibility, special-token mapping, and a small smoke-run (100 queries) using canonical probes. fail -> block promotion.
ben: gating thresholds suggestion: quality delta on canonical probes > -0.2% and p95 latency within +30ms -> auto-promote; borderline -> CS review.
zoe: rollouts: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with eval at each step. if any gate fails, auto-rollback and compute credit per tier.
meera: credit tiers proposal: seed $1k, uplift $7.5k, enterprise $35k. vesting: 50% at day 7, remainder at day 21. clawback clause if account churns within 30 days.
carlos: automation APIs: POST /soft-landing/start -> returns migration_id; webhook events for phase changes; POST /credits/apply requires idempotency_key and returns event_id.
billing-bot: noted - sample required payload: {contract_id, approval_code, ledger_event_id, amount_cents, migration_id}. will return event_id and posted_at. idempotency_key needed.
ben: ops note: tag metrics/traces with migration_id so SRE can filter. emit lifecycle events to kafka for downstream dashboards.
zoe: next steps: carlos to spec API payloads + idempotency behavior; meera to draft preflight tests and canonical probe bundle; ben to add tracing tags and cost-surcharge flag; billing-bot will mock apply endpoint. i'll book a 20m sync Fri. please comment in the doc not here.
